banner.title: The fighting sub-classes round - Childers and Kay's Samurai (folio 25) and Pickens' Berserker (folio 27)
banner.provenance: Pinned from The Dragon Vol. 1 No. 3 (October 1976): folio 25, Mike Childers' Samurai as modified by Jeff Kay - the Fighting Man sub-class with the dexterity-above-15 gate, the daisho and the yumi, the four-grade katana and wakizashi critical-hit tables, the three-band critical blow on the percentage dice, the five-point dexterity ladder, the five-grade Japanese armor run and the judo rules with their 4-level damage and 6-level subdue steps; folio 27, John Pickens' Berserker - the highly experimental human NEUTRAL with Strength and Constitution above 9 and Intelligence below 9, the five lycanthropic clans with their Clanmasters, the wereshape at 6th through 10th, the level abilities, the 2-12 Followers with their three percentile rolls, and the berserking chance with its cumulative adders. The editor's caution rides: the class is highly experimental, be warned.
banner.sentinel: The variant-layer doctrine holds: Dragon ink is never core 1e canon. The 'greater than 15' and 'exceed 9' gates CONVERT to 16 and 10 minimums and 'below 9' to an 8 maximum, every conversion noted, never silent; the '00' percentile convention CONVERTS to 100; the wakizashi's 1 and 3/4 pounds pins as seven quarter-pounds; the blade critical bands pin as their low roll with the top always 20; the OCR's duplicate Magic-User Follower row and the garbled yumi armor-class grid ride AS SCANNED - the grid's stacked modifier tokens carry no figure pixels to check and pin nothing, noted; the Samurai and Berserker ride the variant layer against the engine's canon class frame, never a rewrite.

consts.comment: add 20 percent if the Berserker bites his shield - voluntary (folio 27)

consts.name: fscBerserkerFootnoteWerebearPct

bools.name: fscSamAnyAlignment
bools.comment: the Samurai may be of any alignment but tends generally to be neutral (folio 25)

bools.name: fscSamPrefersDaisho
bools.comment: the Samurai preferentially carries the traditional daisho sword pair and the Japanese composite longbow (folio 25)

bools.name: fscSamKatanaLossVendetta
bools.comment: a Samurai whose katana is taken will pursue a vendetta against the thief or his employers, or commit seppeku - the exact action mutually agreeable between player and gamemaster (folio 25)

bools.name: fscSamBladesNonMagical
bools.comment: the Japanese-style blades are special though non-magical (folio 25)

bools.name: fscSamTwoWeaponsAtOnce
bools.comment: the Samurai may employ katana and wakizashi at the same time, one in each hand, against the same or different targets (folio 25)

bools.name: fscSamSeldomShield
bools.comment: a Samurai very seldom used a shield (folio 25)

bools.name: fscSamJudoUnarmedOnly
bools.comment: judo may be used by a Samurai only if he has no weapon in his hands (folio 25)

bools.name: fscSamJudoVsUnarmedPreferred
bools.comment: the judo techniques were generally reserved for use against unarmed opponents unless necessity dictated otherwise (folio 25)

bools.name: fscSamYumiAnyPosture
bools.comment: the Japanese composite longbow - the yumi - may be fired standing, kneeling or on horseback (folio 25)

bools.name: fscBerserkerExperimental
bools.comment: the class is highly experimental - only the boys in the 16-plus club are likely to do well at this, be warned (folio 27)

bools.name: fscBerserkerHumanOnly
bools.comment: the Berserker is a Fighting Man sub-class of humans (folio 27)

bools.name: fscBerserkerNeutralOnly
bools.comment: the Berserker must be NEUTRAL (folio 27)

bools.name: fscBerserkerNoMagicArmorShield
bools.comment: the Berserker may use any magical items available to Fighters with the exception of armor and shields (folio 27)

bools.name: fscBerserkerDoubleKillPoints
bools.comment: in addition to any strength experience bonuses the Berserker receives double points for kills until he earns his wereshape (folio 27)

bools.name: fscBerserkerNeverPsionic
bools.comment: the Berserker may never develop psionic powers (folio 27)

bools.name: fscBerserkerWereshapeBonuses
bools.comment: the Berserker takes his clan's wereshape when berserk, receiving all hit and damage bonuses (folio 27)

bools.name: fscBerserkerNoLycanthropePowers
bools.comment: the Berserker does not receive any of the special characteristics of lycanthropes (folio 27)

bools.name: fscBerserkerWereshapeMeleeMagicOnly
bools.comment: while in wereshape the Berserker may melee creatures vulnerable only to magical weaponry (folio 27)

bools.name: fscBerserkerInsanityIsWereshape
bools.comment: insanity will always involve reversion to wereshape (folio 27)

bools.name: fscBerserkerSpeaksLycanthropic
bools.comment: at wereshape the Berserker gains the lycanthropic language in human form and empathic command over normal animals of his clan type (folio 27)

bools.name: fscBerserkerShieldbrothersFriendly
bools.comment: shieldbrothers will always be friendly and help each other when possible - failure means outlawry and open season on the outcast (folio 27)

bools.name: fscBerserkerFollowersNeverReplaced
bools.comment: if killed, the Berserker's Followers may never be replaced (folio 27)

bools.name: fscBerserkCompanionDeathAuto
bools.comment: the death of the Companion causes an automatic berserk (folio 27)

bools.name: fscBerserkerCannotWithdrawBerserk
bools.comment: a Berserker may not withdraw from melee while berserk (folio 27)

bools.name: fscBerserkerNeverCauseLycanthropy
bools.comment: Berserkers never cause lycanthropy (folio 27)

tables.name: fscKatanaBlades
col_comments: the hit and damage modifier grade - 0 through +3 (folio 25)
the 'above to hit' number - 8+ down to 5+ (folio 25)
the automatic critical roll band's low roll - 20, then 19-20, 19-20, then 18-20; the band top always 20 (folio 25)
the encumbrance - 50 down to 40 (folio 25)
the value in gold pieces - 18 through 960 (folio 25)
tables.audit_comment: the katana grades - the chance of critical hit table for the Japanese long sword, blades approximately 30 inches and 3 pounds (folio 25)

tables.name: fscWakizashiBlades
col_comments: the hit and damage modifier grade - 0 through +3 (folio 25)
the 'above to hit' number - 8+, 8+, then 7+, 7+ (folio 25)
the automatic critical roll band's low roll - 20, 20, then 19-20, 19-20; the band top always 20 (folio 25)
the encumbrance - 28 down to 23 (folio 25)
the value in gold pieces - 16 through 800 (folio 25)
tables.audit_comment: the wakizashi grades - the chance of critical hit table for the Japanese short sword, blades approximately 24 inches and 1 and 3/4 pounds (folio 25)

tables.name: fscSamCritTable
col_comments: the percentile band's low roll - 01, 81, 96 (folio 25)
the percentile band's high roll - 80, 95, 00 pinned as 100, the '00' conversion noted (folio 25)
the percent of maximum hit points dealt - 25, 50, 100 (folio 25)
the flat hit-point minimum where greater - 6, 12, then 0 for the instant kill, the 'whichever is greater' pairing noted (folio 25)
the limb-loss code - 1 rolls a 1-4 limb (right arm, left arm, right leg, left leg); 0 is no additional loss, the decapitation noted (folio 25)
tables.audit_comment: the critical blow table on the percentage dice - 01-80 a quarter of maximum hit points or 6 with a 1-4 limb roll, 81-95 half or 12 with a major body hit, 96-00 decapitation or other instant kill (folio 25)

tables.name: fscSamArmorGrades
col_comments: the grade rank - 1 through 5 for E, D, C, B, A, the letters carried in the audit comment (folio 25)
the armor class - 6 down to 3, with B and A both 3 (folio 25)
the encumbrance - 400, 400, 575, 675, 625 (folio 25)
the value in gold pieces - 40 through 600 (folio 25)
tables.audit_comment: the Japanese armor grades E, D, C, B, A - European plate's protection at 45 pounds maximum, protection sacrificed for speed where necessary; B is heavier than A at 675 against 625 (folio 25)

tables.name: fscBerserkerClans
col_comments: the clan rank - 1 through 5 for Wererat, Werewolf, Wereboar, Weretiger, Werebear (folio 27)
the advance-as code - 1 Cleric, 2 Druid, 3 Fighter, the words carried in the audit comment (folio 27)
the level the clan earns its wereshape - 6th through 10th (folio 27)
the level the clan gains its Followers - 8th through 12th (folio 27)
the clan's maximum hit dice - 9 through 12 (folio 27)
the Clanmaster's level - 11th through 15th (folio 27)
tables.audit_comment: the five clans - Wererat advances as Cleric, Werewolf and Wereboar as Druid, Weretiger and Werebear as Fighter; each has one Clanmaster, combat for the top spot being detailed under Monks and Druids in the supplements (folio 27)

tables.name: fscFollowerTypes
col_comments: the percentile band's low roll - the '01' and '00' conventions pinned as 1 and 100 (folio 27)
the percentile band's high roll (folio 27)
the type code - 1 Fighter, 2 Magic User, 3 Elf, 4 Dwarf, 5 Extraordinary (folio 27)
tables.audit_comment: the Follower type roll - 01-60 Fighter, 61-70 Magic User, 71-80 Elf, 81-90 Dwarf, 91-00 Extraordinary; the OCR's duplicate Magic-User row pins AS SCANNED with both rows at 61-70 (folio 27)

tables.name: fscFollowerLevels
col_comments: the percentile band's low roll (folio 27)
the percentile band's high roll (folio 27)
the Follower's level - 2nd through 7th (folio 27)
tables.audit_comment: the Follower level roll - 01-50 2nd, 51-65 3rd, 66-80 4th, 81-90 5th, 91-99 6th, 00 7th pinned as 100 (folio 27)

tables.name: fscExtraordinary
col_comments: the percentile band's low roll (folio 27)
the percentile band's high roll (folio 27)

audit_comment: THE FIGHTING SUB-CLASSES ROUND - round C of the issue-3 walk. Childers/Kay's Samurai: the dexterity-above-15 gate pinned as 16, any alignment tending neutral, the daisho and yumi preference, the vendetta-or-seppeku on katana loss, the special-but-non-magical Japanese blades with 9+ identification and 13+ exact reading, the katana and wakizashi critical-hit tables (the 'above to hit' numbers 8+ to 5+, the automatic critical bands pinned as their low rolls, encumbrances and values), the one-step loss in non-Samurai or single-handed hands with the zero floor, the two-weapon permission, the three-band critical blow table (25 percent or 6 with the 1-4 limb roll, 50 percent or 12, the decapitation), the five-point dexterity ladder at 8,000 through 616,000, the five-grade Japanese armor run E through A at 45 pounds maximum with the shield seldom, the judo rules (empty hands only, the 1-2 turn recovery, 1-4 damage on 19-20 at +5 percent per 4 levels, the subdue on 20 at +5 percent per 6 levels), and the yumi costs. Pickens' Berserker: the highly experimental human NEUTRAL, Strength and Constitution above 9 pinned as 10, Intelligence below 9 pinned as 8, armor class no better than 6 at first level, no magical armor or shields, double kill points until the wereshape, never psionic, the five clans with their advance-as codes, wereshape levels, follower levels, maximum dice and Clanmaster levels, +1 armor class per two levels, the level abilities (surprise at 4th, detection and the 4th-level Companion at 6th, hiring at 10th at -2 loyalty capped 15), the 2-12 Followers at 16-plus loyalty with the Bard of level 3-6 never replaced, the three percentile follower rolls, the berserking chance (10 base, +20 shield bite, +10 per round cumulative, +10 per witnessed death, the Companion's death automatic), the berserk edges (+2 attacks, +6 with a magic sword, psionic immunity) and locks (no withdrawal), the fit's end (10 percent turn-on less 1 percent per level to a 1 percent minimum, 0 for a Clanmaster, the full turn of rest), never causing lycanthropy, and the footnote adjustments by clan. HONEST BOUNDARIES: the OCR's duplicate Magic-User follower row pins as scanned; the yumi armor-class modifier grid garbles beyond numeric pinning - the OCR stacked two modifier rows into single tokens, no figure pixels to check - and pins nothing, the yumi costs and encumbrances pinned instead; both sub-classes ride the variant layer, the Berserker experimental per its author's caution.
